@concat('"SELECT DISTINCT BGBG.BGBG_ID AS CONTRACT_CODE,
       MEMD.MEME_CK,
       MEMD.GRGR_CK,
       MEMD2.MEMD_EVENT_CD AS HICNEVENT,
       MEMD2.MEMD_INPUT_DT AS HICN_INPUT_DT,
       MEMD2.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT AS HICN_EFF_DT,
       MEMD2.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT AS HICN_TERM_DT,
       MEMD2.MEME_HICN,
       MEMD1.MEMD_EVENT_CD AS PBP_EVENT,
       MEMD1.MEMD_INPUT_DT AS PBP_INPUT_DT,
       MEMD1.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT AS PBP_EFFDT,
       MEMD1.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT AS PBP_TERMDT,
       MEMD1.MEMD_MCTR_PBP AS PBP,
       MEMD.MEMD_EVENT_CD AS SCCC_EVENT,
       MEMD.MEMD_INPUT_DT AS CONTRACT_INPUT_DT,
       MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT AS SCCC_EFFDT,
       MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT AS SCCC_TERMDT
FROM FACETS.CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL MEMD 
INNER JOIN CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = MEMD.BGBG_CK AND BGBG.BGBG_MCTR_TYPE = ''HCFA'' AND MEMD.MEMD_EVENT_CD =''SCCC''
LEFT JOIN CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL MEMD1 ON MEMD1.MEME_CK=MEMD.MEME_CK AND MEMD1.GRGR_CK=MEMD.GRGR_CK AND MEMD1.MEMD_EVENT_CD=''PBP''
LEFT JOIN CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL MEMD2 ON  MEMD2.MEME_CK=MEMD.MEME_CK AND MEMD2.GRGR_CK=MEMD.GRGR_CK AND MEMD2.MEMD_EVENT_CD=''HICN'' 
WHERE (TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_Cov_From_Dt')), '"'',''MM/DD/YYYY'') BETWEEN TRUNC(MEMD2.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT) AND TRUNC(MEMD2.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT)
OR TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_Cov_To_Dt')), '"'',''MM/DD/YYYY'') BETWEEN TRUNC(MEMD2.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT) AND TRUNC(MEMD2.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT))
AND (TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_Cov_From_Dt')), '"'',''MM/DD/YYYY'') BETWEEN TRUNC(MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT) AND TRUNC(MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT)
OR TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_Cov_To_Dt')), '"'',''MM/DD/YYYY'') BETWEEN TRUNC(MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT) AND TRUNC(MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT))
AND (TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_Cov_From_Dt')), '"'',''MM/DD/YYYY'') BETWEEN TRUNC(MEMD1.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT) AND TRUNC(MEMD1.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT)
OR TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_Cov_To_Dt')), '"'',''MM/DD/YYYY'') BETWEEN TRUNC(MEMD1.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT) AND TRUNC(MEMD1.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT))
"', variables('gv_Query_Contract_Filter'))

gv_AuditData_Load_Query_B.value: 'SELECT DISTINCT AGP.CONTRACT,        AGP.PBP,        SBSB.SBSB_ID,        GRGR.GRGR_ID,        GRGR.GRGR_NAME,        BGBG.BGBG_ID,        MEME.MEME_HICN,        BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,        BLBL.BLBL_END_DT,        BLBL.BLBL_CREATE_DTM,        BLBL_BILLED_AMT,        BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT,        BLBL.BLBL_SPCL_BL_IND,        BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST,        MEPE.CSCS_ID,        MEPE.CSPI_ID,        INSB.PDPD_ID,        INSB.BLSB_PREM_SB,        INSB.PDBL_ID,        INSB.BLSB_COV_DUE_DT,        INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT,        INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT,        INSB.BLSB_DISP_CD,        BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL,SBSB.SBSB_CK  FROM AGP.HICN_CONTRACT_PBP AGP  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB     ON AGP.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR   ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME    ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK     AND AGP.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE   ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD   ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP   ON SBSP.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG   ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = SBSD.BGBG_CK  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI   ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK =  BGBG.BGBG_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL   ON BLBL.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB   ON INSB.BLIV_ID = BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST    AND INSB.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK WHERE TRUNC(INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT)>= TO_DATE('01/01/2018','MM/DD/YYYY')        AND TRUNC(INSB.BLSB_COV_THRU_DT) <= TO_DATE('12/31/2018','MM/DD/YYYY')      AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT      AND BLBL.BLBL_SPCL_BL_IND NOT IN ( 'S' )      AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT BETWEEN SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT AND SBSP.SBSP_TERM_DT      AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT BETWEEN AGP.HICN_EFF_DT AND AGP.HICN_TERM_DT      AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT BETWEEN AGP.PBP_EFF_DT AND AGP.PBP_TERM_DT      AND INSB.BLSB_COV_FROM_DT BETWEEN AGP.SCCC_EFF_DT AND AGP.SCCC_TERM_DT      AND BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT != 0      AND INSB.BLSB_PREM_SB! = 0   '
